case_title: Om Prakash v. State of Haryana
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302 rlw s.149 and s.148
aggravating_circumstances: Unlawful assembly, use of weapons, multiple injuries
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Sections 148 and 302 rlw 149 IPC
neutral_facts: The accused, part of an unlawful assembly, inflicted injuries on the victim using lathis and a gun. The victim was run over by a tractor, leading to severe injuries and eventual death. The prosecution presented eyewitness accounts and medical evidence corroborating the assault. The trial court convicted the accused under Sections 148 and 302 of the IPC, with the High Court affirming the conviction. The Supreme Court upheld the conviction, rejecting challenges regarding the delay in lodging the FIR and the attribution of specific acts to each accused. The evidence indicated a common object of the unlawful assembly, with injuries caused by both lathi blows and the tractor.
